x-rules.seal: manifest_sha256 is SHA-256 of the record excluding that key, serialized as sorted-key JSON with ASCII escapes and no whitespace.
x-rules.ordering: Stream and case identifiers are unique and sorted. Source placement is consistent within the corpus and across its predecessor chain.
x-rules.terms: Every stream pins the source rights and sensitivity, including retention and derived-frame permission. These terms must satisfy scenario_rights at use time.
x-rules.cases: Cases inherit parent source, group, split and encounter; windows and regions lie within their parent. label_transform is the deterministic result of the pinned transform and seed.
